# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_ANGLE_EXTREME_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A sharp upward turn of the EMA ribbon after a flat/slightly down period signals acceleration, providing a long entry opportunity. This setup captures momentum when the short-term EMA (EMA8) begins to rise steeply while the medium and long EMAs (EMA21, EMA55) remain aligned, indicating the start of a trending move.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Require EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55 and EMA8 slope (EMA8 – EMA8[5])/5 > 0.001*price; additionally, the prior four bars must have had EMA8 slope <= 0. Enter long at the close of the bar when the condition first turns true.  
**Exit:** Chart‑stop at the low of the breakout bar, TP1 at 2R, runner trail using a chandelier exit (ATR*3). Regime filter: only consider entries when price is above the 200‑period EMA and VIX < 20.
